page.title: Wiki
page.description: Searchable, revisioned Markdown knowledge for the workspace, projects, and personal notes.

scope_hints.user: Personal pages follow you across every workspace and never become LM Wiki evidence.

fields.path_hint: Relative .md path, e.g. index.md or concepts/agents.md
fields.title: Title

empty.title: No wiki pages yet
empty.description: Create a Markdown page to start capturing knowledge in this scope.
empty.pick_project: Select a project to browse its wiki.

states.action_error: The action could not be completed. Try again.

search.label: Search Wiki
search.minimum: Enter at least two characters to search.
search.empty: No Wiki pages match this search.

history.title: Revision history
history.description: Compare immutable revisions or restore an older version as a new revision.
history.restore_description: Revision {{number}} will become a new revision. Existing history stays unchanged.

proposals.empty_description: Agent edits appear here for human review before they can change shared knowledge.
proposals.reject_description: The proposal stays in history with your review decision.
proposals.stale: This proposal is based on an older revision. Reload the page and review it against the latest content.

conflict.title: This page changed while you were editing
conflict.description: The server is now on revision {{number}}. Reload its version or keep your draft and merge it manually.
conflict.merge_description: Your draft is preserved. Compare it with the current server version before saving.
conflict.stale_restore: The page changed before the restore completed. Reload history and try again.

delete_dialog.title: Delete this Wiki page?
delete_dialog.description: The page and its shared references will be removed. This action cannot be undone.

personal.title: Personal Wiki
personal.description: Private, cross-workspace Markdown notes that only you can read and edit. Personal pages never become shared LM Wiki evidence.
personal.search_placeholder: Search your titles, paths, and content
personal.empty_description: Create a private Markdown page that stays available even when you leave a workspace.
personal.delete_description: The live page will be removed. Its immutable revision links remain available only to you.

revision.title: Wiki revision
revision.description: This immutable snapshot preserves the exact content and provenance of the cited revision.
revision.error: This revision could not be loaded or is no longer available to you.
revision.copy_error: The citation could not be copied.

source_policy.title: LM Wiki sources
source_policy.description: Choose evidence classes and pin exact Wiki revisions for the next LM Wiki refresh.
source_policy.remote_description: Off by default. Enable only when this workspace may use remote generation.
source_policy.remote_owner_only: Only workspace owners and admins can change remote generation.
source_policy.remote_exclusions: Local-only sources and personal Wiki pages are always excluded.
source_policy.exclusion_personal_reason: Private personal scope never becomes shared evidence.
source_policy.exclusion_local_only_reason: Local-only content never leaves the owner's daemon.
source_policy.save_error: The source policy could not be saved.
source_policy.read_only: Only workspace owners and admins can change this policy.
source_policy.personal_excluded: Personal pages are private and cannot be LM Wiki evidence.
